purpose: CMF material and color board — showing the four color tokens and three material textures that define the product's warm, tactile identity
prompt:
CMF (Color, Material, Finish) design board for an AI companion device for elderly users. Professional industrial design presentation on matte cloud white (#E8E4DF) background.

TOP SECTION — Color palette: Four large circular swatches arranged horizontally:
1. warm-shell #F2EDE8 — warm ceramic white (primary body)
2. soft-stone #D4CFC9 — soft warm gray (silicone accents)
3. gentle-amber #E8C9A0 — pale amber warm light (breathing light accent)
4. fabric-mist #C8C3BC — woven fabric gray (speaker mesh)

MIDDLE SECTION — Material samples: Three rectangular material swatches showing actual texture:
1. Matte ceramic plastic — fine-grain unglazed porcelain texture, warm white
2. Soft-touch silicone — smooth rubber-like matte surface, warm gray, skin-friendly
3. Woven fabric mesh — fine textile weave pattern, gray, acoustic-transparent

BOTTOM SECTION — Product application: A detail photo of the actual device showing where each material is applied — ceramic body, silicone base, fabric speaker zone, with subtle callout lines.

Clean structured layout, professional design board aesthetic. Soft even lighting. No glossy or metallic finishes visible. Warm neutral palette throughout.
negative_prompt: glossy, shiny, metallic, chrome, pure black, cold white, high saturation, messy layout, random gradients, glowing effects, medical appearance, small text, complex graphics
